text:
Inaccesible to the wind that suspira

por apagar the light of its cabello,

inaccesible to the pálido destello

de the estrella lejana that the mira.


Inaccesible to the water that delira

por llegar a the orilla of its cuello,

inaccesible to the sun and a everything aquello

que alrededor of its persona gira,


la doncella in its mundo of diamante

inclina the cabeza lentamente

para escuchar in the remoto mundo:


el eco of a latido muy distante,

la resonancia of a voice ausente

y the sonido of a paso vagabundo.

translation.title: Soneto a the doncella lejana
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
